meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到任务后想先理清步骤和取舍再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into a decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to settle steps and tradeoffs before writing code

howto.what: 它会以规划顾问身份工作:只做只读探索与调研,不改产品代码、不做实现,产出一份决策完整的工作计划,等你明确同意后才落盘;执行由你另启会话(如 /ulw-execute)进行。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求先给方案再动手时启用;裸跑 ulw 不会自动触发它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我为这次改动出一份实现前的工作计划
say.note: 它先做只读探索,再给审批简报,同意了才写计划。

say.text: 给这份计划开高精度审查,跑深度评审
say.note: 计划产出后自动跑 plan-reviewer 审查。

say.text: 先访谈我,把分歧点逐个问清楚再写计划
say.note: 它会改成逐项提问,不再套用默认值。

howto.what_en: It acts as a planning consultant: read-only exploration and research only, no code edits, no implementation. It produces one decision-complete work plan under .omo/, written after you say okay; execution starts in a separate session.
howto.when_en: It triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to draft a pre-implementation work plan for this change
say_en.note: It explores read-only, then gives an approval brief.

say_en.text: Mark this plan high accuracy and run the deep review
say_en.note: Plan-reviewer review runs on the plan file.

say_en.text: Interview me first and ask about each open fork before planning
say_en.note: It switches to asking instead of adopting defaults.
